apps.name: JWLink
apps.author: jgm240
apps.description: Companion app for the JWatch (Bluetooth LE)
apps.long: Scan for and connect to your JWatch, sync the time, find the watch, set Do Not Disturb, rename it and read battery, heart rate, steps and firmware. Needs a working Bluetooth adapter (hci0) with bluez + gatttool on the phone.

system.notes: First store release: Store, software updater, JWLink, icon styles, audio, news, weather, YouTube downloader.
